question: I have a question. Can you put bananas in Whitebeard's mustache? Is it a banana pocket?
answer: That's right... If you open the zipper on the back side, bananas will come out. If you line them up in single file, 3 fits on the right side and 3 on the left side, so 6 is the total capacity, I guess... "Men! Time for battle! Have bananas! Gurararara!" What do you guys think of Whitebeard, really?
name: Samusamu
